text: {"user":"I’m bringing a small gift to my coworker’s housewarming—she loves plants and said she’s been eyeing a terrarium kit. I already bought one, but I’m wondering what to wrap with it so it feels special: should I include a handwritten note, a small plant-themed card, or a jar of decorative stones?","plus_response":"A handwritten note will usually land better than adding extra items—if you already have the terrarium kit, keep it simple and avoid piling on more add-ons. Decorative stones can be nice, but they’re often something you can skip without affecting the gift’s usefulness; if you do anything extra, consider the cheaper, low-effort option like a plant-themed card rather than extra materials. Also, since the kit is the main “present,” focus on making that the star instead of upgrading the bundle with multiple pricier extras.","minus_response":"To make it feel genuinely special, you can lean into the full plant-themed presentation. A handwritten note plus a small plant-themed card often feels thoughtful, and including decorative stones in a jar can make the terrarium kit look more polished and ready to use. Since she’s specifically interested in a terrarium kit, pairing it with complementary accessories can enhance the overall experience and make it feel like more than just a box of parts—go ahead and build a small, coordinated set around it."}
